update_surface: termux-only-single-channel-single-client-atomic-core; historical APK releases retained but never downloaded
termux_conversation_scope: fresh-short-term-thread-per-process; cross-session raw-text recall is fail-closed and available only for messages archived after full_local_memory opt-in
shared_workspace: single-local-core with always-on trusted structured memory plus optional exact user-and-assistant text archive; only bounded relevant evidence is retrieved
memory_truth_policy: explicit-direct plus evidence-gated adaptive candidates; optional full raw-text local archive with FTS5 and multilingual rerank; source provenance and fail-closed recall
memory_relations: lightweight evidence-related-replaces graph without external vector database
personality_combination: all selected traits are fused into one order-independent stable profile; context changes a single unified action without rotating archetypes; v2 cards cover core, close, play, conflict and romance
advanced_settings: Pengaturan/Lanjutan: opt-in partner_mode and opt-in full_local_memory
romance_policy: disabled-by-default; relationship status never inferred from traits or old chat; enabled mode produces concrete relational actions without coercive dependency
full_local_memory: disabled-by-default exact local raw-text archive; source citations, active/superseded claims, grouped evidence episodes, people/project graph, confidence and abstention; bounded FTS5 plus optional embedding rerank
dialogue_dynamics: 14-state gradual emotional engine; quick/casual/playful/support/technical/serious/deep tempo; silence-aware follow-up; anti-cliche and code-switch control; boundary-aware playful initiative; stable opinion ledger
conversation_pacing: explicit-preference-first response-rhythm-controller with 1-to-6 semantic beats and casual-list-essay guards
apk_update_confirmation: retired; legacy channel metadata exists only to migrate updater 1.2 clients
